# Ny orderkross från ABB – Limes vd om kvartalet

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon dug into Q3 reports. ABB posted its ninth straight quarter of orders beating expectations, driven by data centers, but the stock fell about 5% on AI-related nervousness. The interviewed CEOs of Byggmax, Scandi Standard, We Sports and Lime were upbeat about their quarters. Sell-side recommendation changes were also covered. The market was weak, with OMXS30 down about 1% after a fading AI bounce on Wall Street.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pareto analyst sees the stock as neutral to slightly positive: strong data-center orders and better margin, but AI sentiment is shaky.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Anders Roslund, Pareto): orders beat for the ninth straight quarter and data-center orders turn into sales in 2027-2029, giving multi-year earnings visibility. Margin of 20.8% is a sign of quality. Risk: data-center orders could fall ~50% once the boom ends, and the AI mood is shaky. Stock +30% YTD, -6% over the past month.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-center order boom ends and orders fall ~50%
- AI/datacenter sentiment deteriorates further
- margin falls back

> *"Den kan vara neutral till lite positiv."*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pareto analyst likes Munters; data-center demand pushes sales growth out for years.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst: data-center order books stretch years ahead, and even if real growth is 15-20% a year for five years, that is very positive for these stocks. Only valuation is uncertain.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-center growth slows well below 15-20%
- valuation stretched

> *"det tycker jag är väldigt positivt för de här aktierna"*
